landmarks.name: Brandenburg Gate
landmarks.hint: An 18th-century neoclassical monument and symbol of German reunification

landmarks.name: Reichstag
landmarks.hint: The historic parliament building with a modern glass dome, rebuilt after reunification

landmarks.name: Berlin TV Tower
landmarks.hint: A 368-metre telecommunications tower built by the GDR, the tallest structure in Germany

landmarks.name: Museum Island
landmarks.hint: A UNESCO World Heritage Site containing five world-renowned museums on a Spree island

landmarks.name: Checkpoint Charlie
landmarks.hint: The most famous crossing point between East and West Berlin during the Cold War

landmarks.name: Berlin Wall Memorial
landmarks.hint: An outdoor memorial preserving a section of the Berlin Wall at Bernauer Strasse

landmarks.name: Potsdamer Platz
landmarks.hint: A bustling public square once bisected by the Berlin Wall, now a modern commercial hub

landmarks.name: East Side Gallery
landmarks.hint: The longest surviving section of the Berlin Wall, transformed into an open-air gallery of murals

landmarks.name: Charlottenburg Palace
landmarks.hint: The largest palace in Berlin, a Baroque and Rococo masterpiece built for Queen Sophie Charlotte

landmarks.name: Berlin Zoological Garden
landmarks.hint: Germany's oldest zoo, with the world's largest collection of species, next to the Tiergarten
